description: Cesis-Turaida-Sigulda full-day Gauja-region tour. Includes Cesu Maize bakery, Cesis Old Town, Cesis Castle ruins (medieval Livonian), Turaida Museum Reserve, Dainu Hill folk sculpture park, Turaida Castle, Gauja Valley viewpoint.
